The main takeaway from our work is that
the negative interest rate is not a puzzle. It is a natural outcome from imperfect arbitrage between money and government bonds.

the power of the arbitrage between government bonds and money/reserves is an important determinant of the term structure of interest rates and that the power of such arbitrage is not constant but time-varying.

a term structure model that incorporates the imperfect arbitrage assumption is more realistic than existing term structure models and that the imperfect arbitrage is a useful tool to analyze the recent monetary policies.
